title: 5c-4: per-component convention discovery
description:
## Parent

sutra/57 — 5c PRD: convention system design

## What to build

Run FCA at two levels: global (all symbols) and per-component (each Layer 1 component's symbols). Conventions are tagged with component scope and checked accordingly.

Key pieces:
- Add nullable `component_id` column to `conventions` table (NULL = global)
- Engine runs global FCA as today, then runs per-component FCA for each component with enough symbols
- Adaptive threshold: `min_support = max(2, ceil(component_symbol_count * 0.4))`. Global retains MIN_SUPPORT=3
- Deduplication: drop component conventions subsumed by a global convention with equal or higher confidence
- `check()` scoped: when checking a symbol, look up its component and check against both global and that component's conventions. Orphan symbols (no component) only checked against globals

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Conventions table has nullable component_id column (migration)
- [ ] Global FCA produces conventions with component_id = NULL
- [ ] Per-component FCA produces conventions scoped to each component
- [ ] Adaptive threshold: small components (e.g., 5 symbols) use min_support=2; large components (e.g., 50 symbols) use min_support=20
- [ ] Component conventions subsumed by global ones are deduplicated
- [ ] check() applies both global and component-scoped conventions to a symbol
- [ ] Symbols not in any component only checked against globals
- [ ] Tests for adaptive threshold, deduplication, and scoped checking

## Blocked by

- sutra/58 (module rename)

Finding relevant to 5c-4:
